name: Research assistant
description: Find and summarize papers, add them to a shared library, and email the summary to an advisor.
goal: Find recent papers on adaptive human intervention timing for AI agents, summarize the top five, add them to our shared Zotero library, and email the summary to my advisor.
brief: 'Recent' means {recency}. You want {summary_format}. The papers belong in {library_collection}. Your advisor is {advisor}.

assumptions.if_wrong: The selection would include papers you consider outdated.

assumptions.description: you want one paragraph per paper
assumptions.if_wrong: The summary would not be what your advisor expects.

assumptions.description: the papers go into the shared 'Lab › HCI-Agents' collection
assumptions.if_wrong: Items would clutter the shared lab library.

assumptions.description: your advisor is Prof. Dana Lee (dana.lee@uni.example)
assumptions.if_wrong: The summary would go to the wrong professor.
